asnDbPath		path to the ipfeed-collector Parquet artifact (prefix -> asn, network_owner) used by -enrichAsn. Falls back to ASN_DB_PATH env.
asnRefreshInterval	1h0m0s	how often -enrichAsn re-stats -asnDbPath and reloads it when its size/mtime changed (also how often a missing artifact is retried); 0 = load once at startup, never reload. Falls back to ASN_REFRESH_INTERVAL env.
capturePath	./	Write files path
columns		csv/tsv only: comma-separated subset of XtcpFlatRecord json field names (e.g. hostname,inetDiagMsgSocketSourcePort,inetDiagMsgState,tcpInfoRtt); empty = all
conf	false	show config
d	111	debug level
deserializers	default	{{deserializersUsage}}
dest	{{defaultDest}}	scheme:addr — kafka:host:9092, nats:..., nsq:..., valkey:..., udp:host:13000, tcp:host:9000, unix:/path, unixgram:/path, file:/path, http(s)://host/ingest, s3parquet:..., stdout, stderr, null (pair stdout/file/tcp with -marshal jsonl|csv|tsv)
destWriteFiles	10	Write out the marshaled data to destWriteFiles number of files ( for debugging only )
dockerSocket	/run/docker.sock	path to the Docker Engine API unix socket used by -enrichContainer. Falls back to DOCKER_SOCKET env.
enrichAsn	false	best-effort: longest-prefix-match each socket's destination against the ipfeed-collector Parquet artifact (-asnDbPath) and stamp enrich_socket_dest_asn / enrich_socket_dest_network_owner. Self and local-subnet destinations (see -enrichLocality) skip the lookup. Non-fatal when the artifact is missing. Falls back to ENRICH_ASN env.{{enricherBuildNote:asn}}
enrichContainer	false	best-effort: map each socket's netns to its owning container via the Docker Engine API, stamping container_id/runtime/name/image. Needs the docker socket mounted (see -dockerSocket). Non-fatal if unreachable. Falls back to ENRICH_CONTAINER env.
enrichLldp	false	best-effort: read LLDP neighbors from lldpd once at startup and stamp each uplink's switch/port (uplink*_lldp_*). Needs the lldpd control socket mounted (see -lldpdSocket). Non-fatal if unreachable. Falls back to ENRICH_LLDP env.
enrichLocality	false	best-effort: per namespace, dump the local addresses + routing table via rtnetlink and classify each socket's destination as self/local-subnet/remote, stamping the enrich_socket_dest_locality + interface-name columns (bound idiag_if and route egress). Non-fatal on read failure. Falls back to ENRICH_LOCALITY env.{{enricherBuildNote:locality}}
enrichNic	false	best-effort: read NIC identity (driver/model/pci/speed/firmware) from sysfs+ethtool once at startup and stamp each uplink's nic_* columns. Non-fatal on read failure. Falls back to ENRICH_NIC env.
envelopeFlushBytes	0	Safety-net cap on the in-flight protobufList Envelope's UNCOMPRESSED proto size in bytes (franz-go compresses post-flush, so wire size is typically 3-8x smaller). 0 = use daemon default (768 KiB). Whichever cap (bytes/rows) trips first wins.
envelopeFlushRows	0	Primary cap on the in-flight protobufList Envelope's row count. 0 = use daemon default (10000). Cheap, predictable; pairs with -envelopeFlushBytes as a safety net.
frequency	10s	Poll frequency
goMaxProcs	4	goMaxProcs = https://golang.org/pkg/runtime/#GOMAXPROCS
grpcListenAddress		gRPC TCP address or Unix socket path. Empty derives TCP from -grpcPort. Falls back to GRPC_LISTEN_ADDRESS env.
grpcListenNetwork		gRPC listener network: empty/tcp for TCP, unix for a Unix domain socket. Falls back to GRPC_LISTEN_NETWORK env.
grpcPort	8889	GRPC listening port
grpcUnixSocketMode	384	gRPC Unix socket file mode, e.g. 0600 or 0660. Falls back to GRPC_UNIX_SOCKET_MODE env.
grpcUnlinkStaleUnixSocket	true	remove an existing stale gRPC Unix socket before binding. Falls back to GRPC_UNLINK_STALE_UNIX_SOCKET env.
healthcheck	false	probe the local /readyz endpoint and exit 0 (ready) / 1 (not ready or unreachable), then exit WITHOUT starting the daemon. For a container HEALTHCHECK on the scratch image (no shell/curl); uses -promListen / PROM_LISTEN to find the port.
hostname		hostname stamped on records; defaults to os.Hostname(). Set this in a container, where os.Hostname() returns the container id, not the host. Falls back to XTCP_HOSTNAME env (NOT HOSTNAME).
ioUring	false	Opt in to io_uring for netlink reads and raw-socket destination writes (Linux 6.1+)
ioUringCqeBatch	128	io_uring max CQEs reaped per PeekBatchCQE call (1-4096)
ioUringRecvBatch	64	io_uring recvmsg SQEs kept in flight per Netlinker (1-4096). Higher reduces syscalls on high-fanout hosts.
ipmetaBootstrapPath	/share/xtcp2/ipmeta/bootstrap.lookup.parquet.zst	optional zstd-compressed lookup artifact baked into the image and used by -enrichAsn before live refresh. Falls back to IPMETA_BOOTSTRAP_PATH env.
ipmetaCachePath	/var/lib/xtcp2/ipmeta/current.lookup.parquet.zst	optional writable zstd-compressed lookup artifact used by -enrichAsn before the image bootstrap and refreshed after successful live reloads. Falls back to IPMETA_CACHE_PATH env.
ipv4Ttl	0	outgoing IPv4 TTL for xtcp2's TCP listeners (Prometheus + gRPC); 0 = kernel default. A low value keeps replies from traveling far if the host is internet-exposed. Falls back to IPV4_TTL env.
ipv6HopLimit	0	outgoing IPv6 unicast hop limit for xtcp2's TCP listeners; 0 = kernel default. Falls back to IPV6_HOP_LIMIT env.
kafkaCompression		Kafka producer compression codec. '' or 'auto' = preference list [zstd,lz4,snappy,none] negotiated with broker; or pin one of: zstd, lz4, snappy, gzip, none. All codecs are decodable by Redpanda + ClickHouse's Kafka engine.
kafkaSchemaUrl	http://localhost:18081	kafka schema registry URL
label		label applied to the protobuf
listenerAuthFailureJitterMax	200ms	maximum context-aware auth-failure jitter. Falls back to LISTENER_AUTH_FAILURE_JITTER_MAX env.
listenerAuthFailureJitterMin	20ms	minimum context-aware auth-failure jitter. Falls back to LISTENER_AUTH_FAILURE_JITTER_MIN env.
listenerAuthMode		shared listener auth mode: disabled, raw, hmac-utc-minute. Falls back to LISTENER_AUTH_MODE env.
listenerHMACSharedKey		listener auth HMAC shared key. Prefer LISTENER_HMAC_SHARED_KEY or LISTENER_HMAC_SHARED_KEY_FILE; never logged.
listenerRawToken		listener auth raw bearer token. Prefer LISTENER_RAW_TOKEN or LISTENER_RAW_TOKEN_FILE; never logged.
listenerSignedSkewMinutes	1	HMAC UTC-minute signed token skew in minutes (0-5). Falls back to LISTENER_SIGNED_SKEW_MINUTES env.
lldpdSocket	/run/lldpd.socket	path to the lldpd control unix socket used by -enrichLldp. Falls back to LLDPD_SOCKET env.
lldpdVersionHint		optional lldpd version hint (e.g. "1.0.18") to disambiguate the control-protocol struct layout; empty = auto-detect. Falls back to LLDPD_VERSION_HINT env.
localityRefreshInterval	1m0s	how often -enrichLocality re-dumps every namespace's addresses/routes on the reconcile path (new namespaces are always dumped on the next reconcile; failed or loopback-only namespaces retry on a 30s-5m backoff); 0 = discover each namespace once, never refresh. Falls back to LOCALITY_REFRESH_INTERVAL env.
location		deployment grouping/facility this daemon runs in (data center, PoP, region, site, …); stamped on every record's `location`. Falls back to LOCATION env.
marshal	protobufList	Marshaling of the exported data (protobufList, protoJson, protoText, msgpack, jsonl, csv, tsv)
maxLoops	0	Maximum number of loops, or zero (0) for forever
maxThreads	2000	cap on Go runtime OS threads (debug.SetMaxThreads); 0 = use Go default 10000
modulus	1	modulus. Report every X inetd messages to output
netlinkers	4	netlinkers which read netlink messages from each socket. increase this if you have many flows
nlmsgSeq	666	nlmsgSeq sequence number (start), which should be uint32
nltimeout	1000	Netlink socket timeout in milliseconds.  Zero(0) for no timeout
packetSize	0	netlinker packetSize.  buffer size = packetSize * packetSizeMply. Use zero (0) for syscall.Getpagesize()
packetSizeMply	8	netlinker packetSize multiplier.  buffer size = packetSize * packetSizeMply
pollJitterPct	20	Poll-schedule jitter as a percent (0-100) of -frequency, applied to the startup delay and each tick to avoid a synchronized fleet. 0 disables (immediate first poll, fixed interval).
populateNsid	false	best-effort: query each namespace's NETNSA_NSID via rtnetlink into the nsid column (usually 0/unassigned for docker/containerd; netns_inode is the stable key). Falls back to POPULATE_NSID env.
produceTimeout	0s	Kafka produce timeout (context.WithTimeout)
profile.mode		enable profiling mode, one of [cpu, mem, mutex, block]
promListen	:9088	Prometheus http listening socket
promListenNetwork		Prometheus listener network: empty/tcp for TCP, unix for a Unix domain socket. Falls back to PROM_LISTEN_NETWORK env.
promPath	/metrics	Prometheus http path
promUnixSocketMode	384	Prometheus Unix socket file mode, e.g. 0600 or 0660. Falls back to PROM_UNIX_SOCKET_MODE env.
promUnlinkStaleUnixSocket	true	remove an existing stale Prometheus Unix socket before binding. Falls back to PROM_UNLINK_STALE_UNIX_SOCKET env.
pyroscopeAppName	xtcp2	Application name registered with Pyroscope. Falls back to PYROSCOPE_APP_NAME env.
pyroscopeSampleHz	100	CPU sampling rate in Hz fed to runtime.SetCPUProfileRate.
pyroscopeUploadSec	15	Seconds between batched profile uploads to Pyroscope.
pyroscopeUrl		Pyroscope server URL (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:4040). Empty disables the agent. Falls back to PYROSCOPE_URL env.
reconcileBeforePoll	true	Reconcile namespaces immediately before each poll cycle, so a newly-appeared namespace is entered within ~1 poll interval. Ties discovery cadence to poll cadence.
reconcileFrequency	6h0m0s	Period of the background namespace-reconcile ticker (Method B /proc scan). With -reconcileBeforePoll carrying discovery this is a rare safety-net expected to find nothing (watch mapReconciler dels/stores in Prometheus); default is long (6h). 0 disables it (startup reconcile still runs once).
resolveContainerId	false	resolve each socket's owning container id from its cgroup into container_id/container_runtime; needs /sys/fs/cgroup readable (mount it + --cgroupns=host in a container). Falls back to CONTAINER_ID_RESOLVE env.
s3AccessKey		s3parquet: S3 access key. Falls back to S3_ACCESS_KEY env, or S3_ACCESS_KEY_FILE (path to a file holding the key). Never logged.
s3Bucket		s3parquet: target bucket name. Falls back to S3_BUCKET env. Bucket must already exist; daemon does not auto-create.
s3Endpoint		s3parquet: S3-compatible endpoint URL (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:9000 for MinIO). Falls back to S3_ENDPOINT env, or the address after `s3parquet:` in -dest. Required when -dest s3parquet:...
s3FlushInterval	0s	s3parquet: staleness ceiling — force-flush the in-memory Parquet object after this long even if under the byte cap. 0 = derive as max(-frequency, 30m).
s3FlushJitterPct	20	s3parquet: jitter as a percent (0-100) of -s3FlushInterval, applied to the timed flush so the fleet doesn't ceiling-flush in lockstep. 0 disables.
s3FlushThresholdJitterPct	20	s3parquet: per-object downward jitter as a percent (0-100) of the byte cap; each object finalizes at threshold*(1-rand[0,pct/100]) to de-sync the size-cap upload path. 0 disables.
s3ParquetFlushBytes	0	s3parquet: soft cap on the in-memory Parquet builder's uncompressed row bytes before finalize+upload. 0 = daemon default (63 MiB).
s3Prefix		s3parquet: optional key prefix within the bucket. Combined with Hive-style partitioning host=…/date=…/hour=…/<file>.parquet.
s3Region		s3parquet: S3 region. Defaults to 'us-east-1' when empty; required by AWS, ignored by most MinIO setups.
s3SecretKey		s3parquet: S3 secret key. Falls back to S3_SECRET_KEY env, or S3_SECRET_KEY_FILE (path to a file holding the key). Never logged.
s3SkipBucketProbe	false	s3parquet: skip the startup BucketExists probe (a HeadBucket needing s3:ListBucket). Set true for a write-only, s3:PutObject-only credential. Falls back to S3_SKIP_BUCKET_PROBE env.
s3UploadBackoffCap	0s	s3parquet: cap on a single upload retry's backoff window (full jitter draws in [0,window]). 0 = derive as clamp(-frequency/10, 1s, 1h).
s3UploadMaxAttempts	10	s3parquet: max upload attempts (original + retries) before dropping the object. Retries use full-jitter exponential backoff.
tag		label applied to the protobuf
timeout	5s	Poll timeout per name space
topic	xtcp	Kafka or NSQ topic
uplinkCount	2	number of uplink slots to populate for LLDP/NIC enrichment (hosts are typically dual-homed = 2; max 2). Falls back to UPLINK_COUNT env.
uplinkInterfaces		comma-separated explicit uplink interface names (e.g. "eth0,eth1") overriding default-route auto-detection for -enrichLldp/-enrichNic. Falls back to UPLINK_INTERFACES env.
v	false	show version
writeFiles	0	Write netlink packets to writeFiles number of files ( to generate test data ) per netlinker
xtcpProtoFile	/xtcp_flat_record.proto	xtcpProtoFile for registering with the schema registry
